ids.title: An argument form keeps its semantic type across different action envelopes
An interrupted repeated relation either keeps one scope or closes before the intervening atom
Independent modifiers commute when they target separate fields

notes: All are unreviewed speculative laws with explicit incompatible rivals and missing inputs.
They are related to prior structural routes but retain distinct falsifiers: commutation, cross-envelope type invariance, and interrupted-scope continuation/reset.
No target reads, counts, images, mixed TSV, reviews, ledger, route or metadata edits.
